offense.troopEmpty: No strikes. Troops deal damage through their actions — add a strike only if this troop also makes weapon Strikes.

troop.notNpc: Cannot apply the troop template to a "{type}" actor — troops must be NPCs.
troop.abilityMissing: Troop ability item not found ({uuid}). The PF2e bestiary glossary pack is missing or out of date.

spellcasting.description: When the troop Casts a Spell, its constituent members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version of the spell than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.
spellcasting.steadyRider: If a reaction would disrupt the troop's spellcasting action, the troop attempts a @Check[flat|dc:12]. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.
spellcasting.steadyHint: Reactions can't easily disrupt the troop's spellcasting — it attempts a DC 12 flat check to ignore the disruption.

convert.sizeHint: The troop's token footprint. Published troops are Gargantuan.
convert.levelDeltaHint: Levels added on conversion. Published troops are the base creature +5.
convert.formUpHint: Adds the Form Up action and halves the splash-damage weakness.
convert.keepStrikesHint: Retain the base creature's strikes instead of replacing them with the generated troop attack actions.
